changes.investigation: current public app-distribution identity / technical migration target
positiveEvidenceAppend: The current iOS application serving Uattzy is App Store id 1372832369, titled 'Uattzy – Stazioni di ricarica'.

The current store listing names Enermia srl as the application provider/developer while copyright is UAU srl, materially linking the legacy Enermia application lineage to the current Uattzy/UAU service without collapsing technical PUN/OCPI partyIds.

Current app listing states the app exposes real-time station availability, can include/exclude roaming networks, and lets users consult prices/tariffs and start/stop charging, making this exact app identity the preferred target for future backend/network capture.
Observed current release line is 9.211.0 dated 2026-07-13 on App Store surfaces.
